evidence.statement: Native factories/pages/stencil, section labels, native actions/rollback, centering, controller routing and Return/Escape. Only scalar native content is card-reflowed; key/controller pages retain native internals.

Native render draws tab/body chrome and dragging state; sidebar mode suppresses that owned instance chrome while child pages and their own stencil/render paths remain native. Zero-height tab hit region and native activation by view id preserve visibility/callback routing.
GameOptions.options stores original GameOption/control refs; apply/store/restoreOriginal/toUI exist. restoreOriginal is open-time rollback, not a verified factory reset.
Native control directions precede unhandled boundary propagation; focus clear/restore; ensureVisible reveals vertically only.
Boundary descendant callbacks; addScrollBars replaces existing bars; native horizontal extent/offset. Owned horizontal bar attached without replacing vertical bar.
Text change calls onTextChangeFunction(target,self); command submit hook, focus/unfocus and text length forwards are native Lua methods.
Native scrollbar constructor and render own horizontal position/extent handling.

options_fit_correction.user_runtime_symptom: Blank categories/search and overflowing Display settings in a 1344x864 Options window at 1920x1080
options_fit_correction.regression: Identical dismissed-popup test fails on source88b019c and passes on current source
findings: ISComboBox.hidePopup removes the shared popup from UIManager without clearing visible. Require parent expansion plus actual UIManager membership for blocking; drawing navigation is independent of ordinary dropdown use.
HorizontalLine decorations retain native full-window widths even when their renderer is suppressed; ignore them for overflow measurement.
ISUIElement.getScrollAreaHeight subtracts hscroll height when hscroll exists, even if hidden; remove unused bars on fitting pages.
ISPanelJoypad.getVisibleElements uses isReallyVisible; retained native rows skip controls hidden through the owned section/page gate.
Section/page controller selection uses native setJoypadFocus/setJoypadFocusTopLeft after clearJoypadFocus; native GameOption/Apply collections remain unchanged.
